item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Shows `dspy.LM(model=\"openai/gpt-5-mini\", temperature=0.7, max_tokens=1000)` raising `ValueError` and asserts the reasoning-model constructor error text requiring `temperature=1.0 or None` and `max_tokens >= 16000 or None`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Demonstrates the valid constructor keeps `16000` under outbound `max_completion_tokens`, while per-call `max_tokens=32` appears separately, evidencing constructor storage via `max_completion_tokens` rather than `max_tokens`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"The overridden call `lm(\"hello\", temperature=0.2, max_tokens=32)` succeeds and the captured outbound kwargs contain those overridden values, demonstrating per-call kwargs were merged on top of constructor kwargs without revalidation."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `mock.patch(\"litellm.completion\", ...)` and inspects `mock_completion.call_args.kwargs`, which directly captures the outbound provider request kwargs."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Provides a runnable end-to-end demo: invalid constructor failure, valid reasoning LM creation, overridden call, printed outbound kwargs, and assertions for `temperature=0.2`, `max_tokens=32`, and retained `max_completion_tokens=16000`."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
